channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Director of San Diego Opera's 'Carmen' promises a magnetic, modern adaptation
item.description: Director Keturah Stickann is neither a native San Diegan nor a current resident, but few San Diego Opera regulars have deeper ties to our local company

item.title: Americana, electronica, mash-ups, and much more: Live music this week
item.description: Country meets jazz meets EDM this week in a glorious series of mash-ups, as well as a heaping serving of more standard musical fare.

item.title: LA28 unveils bold, superbloom-inspired look for the Los Angeles Olympics
item.description: The concept is based on a California superbloom, a rare and vibrant explosion of wildflowers across hills, valleys and deserts.

item.title: Port awards $2.9M contract for wildlife-friendly shoreline projects in San Diego Bay
item.description: A contractor is preparing to install wildlife-friendly shoreline structures in San Diego Bay after receiving approval earlier this month.

item.title: San Diego nonprofit among groups feeding TSA officers as government shutdown drags on
item.description: Collections are popping up to help Transportation Security Administration officers who have been without full pay for more than a month.

item.title: San Diego County high schools honored for college dual enrollment programs
item.description: Several high schools in San Diego County have been recognized by state education officials for their dual enrollment programs.

item.title: Keep It Saucy! – Holiday treats too good to Passover
item.description: With Easter, Passover, and so many more wonderful holidays around the corner, here are two of my favorite recipes to enjoy.

item.title: Surf coach rescues father, daughter caught in Oceanside Harbor rip current
item.description: A surf coach is being credited with rescuing a father and daughter caught in an Oceanside rip current during a surf competition this month.

item.title: County begins independent audit after ex-con COO charged with embezzlement
item.description: The county is formally reviewing its internal contracting processes following embezzlement charges against a nonprofit executive.

item.title: Above-average heat to grip San Diego County through Friday
item.description: High pressure aloft will keep temperatures well above seasonal averages across San Diego County Tuesday and continuing through Friday.

item.title: Is Kaiser’s labor-management model unraveling?
item.description: Health care workers say the system’s push for growth is undermining a once-vaunted partnership — and affecting patients.

item.title: California's immigrant families fear losing benefits amid public charge confusion
item.description: Officials can deny green card and visa applications if they determine the applicant is likely to rely heavily on government assistance.

item.title: TJ Maxx and Ulta Beauty bring new shopping options to La Mesa
item.description: Defying a trend of stores closing elsewhere, TJ Maxx and Ulta Beauty both opened for business this month at Grossmont Center.
